claim_under_review: c1_close=YES_XSIM and c1_800k_closed=true are licensed as Master §7 XSim law close (not BOARD).

Scale and sweep GOLDEN.json SHA256 3b900979… MATCH each other and GOLD_HASH_PRE_XVLOG.
scale xsim SHA 92aad0c7… and sweep xsim SHA 9d95f83e… MATCH 2148Z.
Independent close-gate re-run exit 0, blocking_fail_ids=[], c1_close=YES_XSIM.
Cartesian is the existing 16k C1 index law (fill_frac=1.0); scale n=800000 is not a 16k clone banner.
what_i_challenge: 2148Z auditor ACCEPT is the same Cursor session that implemented the bags (disclosed, still a process defect vs 2045Z 'auditor does not implement').
CAND_CAP_FINAL=16 is frozen on an 800k image where high_occupancy AND emit_n=1, so the cap never binds; 16k KEEP already bound cap=16 with emit_n=16 tp=1 fp_fill0=15 prec_all_x1000=62.

strongest_counter_argument: YES_XSIM can be read as a self-audit that destressed the one class (high occupancy) which previously proved CAND_CAP binds. If auditor ACCEPT requires a different model, keep the XSim facts and treat 2148Z as nominated, not countersigned. That does not license BOARD_PASS and does not require deleting the scale bags.

next_action: Keep YES_XSIM and BOARD REJECT. Do not reopen XSim for cartesian. C2 persist identity only if Anh asks after this RCA; PROGRAM=NO. Optional: second-model read of 2148Z.
